title: Hearty Silky Greek Guanciale Lasagna
description: A jammy, silky lasagna infused with Greek flavors and rustic guanciale, baked to perfection in a wood-fired ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 200C and lightly oil a ceramic tagine.
In a skillet, cook guanciale over medium heat until crisp, then set aside to drain on paper towels.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent, then add crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, pepper and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then shock in ice water and squeeze dry.
Whisk ricotta, beaten egg, feta and a pinch of salt into a bowl until silky smooth.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce in the tagine, layer lasagna sheets, guanciale, spinach and ricotta mixture, repeating until all layers are used, ending with sauce.
Cover with foil and bake in the oven for 35 minutes, then remove foil and bake another 10 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Let the lasagna sit for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
